title: LEAN MANUFACTURING SYSTEMS ENGINEERING
description: Emphasizes the design, implementation, evaluation, and control of manufacturing systems, and the integration of lean manufacturing theory and methods. Examines manufacturing processes/equipment and systems, e.g., manufacturing system design, production planning/control, and inventory/resource management.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: ENGR 390, 391 or 391H.
A minimum grade of C is required in ENGR 390, ENGR 391 and ENGR 391H.
meeting_html: F 12pm-1:50pm in ROG 330 - Rogers Hall 330 (9/23 to 12/4)
